codingPractices.title: Modern PHP Features
codingPractices.description: Utilize features of PHP 7.4+ (typed properties, arrow functions) where applicable

codingPractices.title: Strict Typing
codingPractices.description: Enable strict typing by adding declare(strict_types=1); at the top of PHP files

codingPractices.title: WordPress APIs
codingPractices.description: Leverage core WordPress functions and APIs wherever possible

codingPractices.title: Error Handling
codingPractices.description: Implement robust error handling with WordPress debug logging, custom handlers, and try-catch blocks

codingPractices.title: Security
items: Always use WordPress's built-in functions for data validation and sanitization
Ensure secure form handling by verifying nonces in submissions
For database: Use $wpdb->prepare() for ALL queries
Input: Use sanitize_* functions before processing
Output: Use esc_* functions before display

codingPractices.title: Database Interactions
items: Apply prepare() statements for all dynamic queries to prevent SQL injection
Use the dbDelta() function for managing database schema changes
